::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/emails/ses"}
#docs
The secret access key is never returned — `secret_configured` reports only whether one is stored. A business runs ONE transport: enabling SES switches SMTP off, which is why `effective_transport` is reported here rather than inferred from `enabled` alone.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `ses_settings`. One of `ses_settings`. |
| `enabled` | `boolean` | When false, this business sends through the deployment-wide MAILER_PROVIDER. |
| `region` | `string` | The AWS region used to send email. |
| `access_key_id` | `string` | Identifies the credential; safe to render. The secret half is never returned. |
| `configuration_set` | `string` | The SES configuration set attached to each send. |
| `secret_configured` | `boolean` | Whether a secret access key is stored. Never the key itself. |
| `effective_transport` | `string` | What this business actually sends through, once SMTP/SES/platform is resolved. |
| `delivers` | `boolean` | Whether that transport can deliver — a configured transport is not necessarily a working one. |
| `effective_from_address` | `string` | The From address used for sends. |
| `effective_from_name` | `string` | The From name used for sends. |
| `from_source` | `string` | Where the From address comes from: this business or the platform. One of `business`, `platform`. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Success |
| `404` | No such business |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/emails/ses" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
```

#response
:::code-group
```json [200 OK]
{
  "object": "ses_settings",
  "enabled": false,
  "region": "us-east-1",
  "access_key_id": "AKIAXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX",
  "configuration_set": "billing-mail",
  "secret_configured": false,
  "effective_transport": "ses",
  "delivers": false,
  "effective_from_address": "billing@example.com",
  "effective_from_name": "Brightwater Analytics",
  "from_source": "business"
}
```

  }
